description:
When will the celebrity career of two-faced actress Min Seo-Hui end?

The popular movie actress Min Seo-Hui's pretty face and excellent acting skills are enough to win the public’s love.

Her shocking secret is that she is a lesbian who has numerous love affairs with fellow entertainers to staff members and even managers! Her agency, unable to tolerate Seo-Hui's numerous relationships, assigns Mi-So, the embodiment of normalcy, as her manager.

There is only one person who failed to succumb to Seo-Hui's advances - Dong-Gyeong, a junior from the theater club she attended during her pre-debut days, who now works as a film director. Reunited at a high school classmate’s funeral, Dong-Gyeong is still aloof. Seo-Hui, whose ego is hurt, takes the lead role in the film director’s independent film in order to seduce the woman she couldn't have… 

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)
